name: PawnChessmon
main_effect:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Deletion] If it's your opponent's turn, you may play 1 level 3 or lower Digimon card with [Chessmon] in its name from your hand without paying its cost. If you have 8 or more Digimon cards with [Chessmon] in its name in their names in your trash, add 2 to the maximum level of the card you can play by this effect.
